facts.fact: Seneweb reports that on 2 October 2025 the Gendarmerie nationale held a workshop presenting and demonstrating ARHIP, a tool to help draft and harmonise proces-verbaux across services, to assess progress in its design and share the templates drawn up so far; how to put it into use in the units that draw up proces-verbaux was still under discussion, and the article does not state the tool's technical form.
facts.system: ARHIP (outil d'Aide à la Rédaction et à l'Harmonisation Inter-services des Procédures judiciaires et administratives)

facts.fact: Seneweb reports that the Gendarmerie nationale hosted and presented the ARHIP tool on 2 October 2025, the workshop co-chaired by its Haut-commandant and the European Union ambassador, the tool having been initiated under phase 2 of the Programme Opérationnel Conjoint (POC II); the article does not say who pays for it.
